attributes.description: Kibana shell for Ingest Watch (internal Stack Monitoring). Add TSVB panels per docs/tsvb-setup.md. Method: day-over-day max(0, primary store delta) per index_stats.index.
attributes.panelsJSON:
[{"version":"8.18.0","type":"markdown","gridData":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":48,"h":8,"i":"method-note"},"panelIndex":"method-note","embeddableConfig":{"enhancements":{},"title":"Method (same as standalone Ingest Watch)","content":"**Internal collection only** (`.monitoring-es-*`, `type:index_stats`).

Daily ingest = per-index day-over-day increase of `index_stats.primaries.store.size_in_bytes`, floored at 0. Replicas excluded. ILM shrinks/deletes do not count as negative ingest. New backing indices contribute full primary size on first seen day.

**Build panels:** see `docs/tsvb-setup.md` — TSVB Max → Terms(`index_stats.index`) → Derivative (1d) → Positive Only → Sum.

**Validate data:** Dev Tools query in `queries/daily_ingest_internal.json` or ES|QL in `esql/`."},"title":"Method (same as standalone Ingest Watch)"}]
